info.title: Afterclass Study API
info.description: Local Bun API. Except status, routes require a Google OAuth access token whose audience matches GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Data is scoped to the verified Google user. Errors use {error,code}. JSON request limit is 300,000 bytes. Authenticated traffic is limited to 120 requests per minute per user per process. Common statuses: 400 validation, 401 Google authorization, 403 origin/account/access, 404 missing resource, 409 concurrent/stale update, 413 body limit, 415 content type, 422 no sources/lesson limit, 429 rate limit, 502 provider failure, 503 missing configuration. CORS is an exact origin allowlist. Google material access is read-only.

post.description: Ranks up to 10 other attached posts using matching topic and title/description terms.

put.description: Existing assessment evidence is retained; supplied evidence is ignored.

delete.summary: Delete all saved data for the authenticated learner
delete.description: Deletes profile, lessons, and cached turns. Does not delete Google resources. Returns 409 while a lesson is updating.
Removes evidence from profile and lessons and clears cached turn snapshots.

get.summary: List up to 100 recent saved lessons

post.summary: Create a lesson from accessible Classroom posts
post.description: Loads current Google sources; per-attachment failures are returned. Up to 40 attachments, 15 MiB per file, 150 PDF pages, 250,000 characters per document and 600,000 characters per lesson.

get.summary: Resume lesson and refresh Google source access

post.description: Google access is rechecked, including retries. Requires configured teaching model and readable sources. Returns 409 for stale revision, concurrent update, or conflicting request ID. Maximum 400 messages per lesson.
Requires configured Realtime model and readable sources. Client uses value for WebRTC. Student tool calls must be submitted to the authoritative turn endpoint; never persist this credential.

get.summary: Fetch authorized PDF preview as base64

post.summary: Generate a reviewable draft; no Google writes
Search authorized Drive files by name
Create a populated Google Doc by importing plain text

get.summary: Read a Google Doc including tabs, passages and revision

patch.summary: Rename, append with revision protection, trash or restore a document

post.summary: Create an assignment with Drive attachments; defaults to DRAFT

patch.summary: Update supported fields of assignments created by this Google project; attachments cannot be changed

post.summary: Prepare, save, get help with, or review an assignment
post.description: Returns the latest lesson with assignment state. Google source access is refreshed before all actions, including idempotent retries. Uses the same bearer authentication, ownership, revision, and concurrency checks as teaching turns. An identical request ID and normalized payload retries idempotently; request IDs cannot be reused across teaching and assignment actions. save works without model configuration or a provider call. prepare/help/review require a configured model and readable sources. Returns 409 for stale revision, concurrent update, or conflicting request ID; 422 for an unavailable selected courseWork post or a review without a draft; 503 for missing model configuration. Never submits to Classroom or writes Google documents.

x.description: Excalidraw scene coordinates, so tutor annotations can sit beside shapes drawn anywhere on the board.

width.description: Nonnegative shape width; for arrows and lines, signed horizontal displacement from x. Negative points left.

height.description: Nonnegative shape height; for arrows and lines, signed vertical displacement from y. Negative points up.

target.description: ID of a scene element the student drew. Text, arrows and lines point at it; rectangles and ellipses ring it. The tutor may only target shapes present on the board.

scene.description: Embedded Excalidraw scene. Board requests are limited to 10 MB.

Board.description: At most 10,000 stroke points total; item IDs must be unique. Items with IDs starting tutor- are the tutor's marks; each annotated reply replaces them and leaves student shapes untouched.

annotated.description: Present when the tutor drew on the whiteboard with this reply.

catchUpMinutes.description: Opt into the four-agent catch-up crew with a time budget. Subsequent turns inherit the saved budget.

boardSnapshot.description: Picture of the student's whiteboard, sent when the question is asked from the Whiteboard tab. The tutor also receives the saved scene's student shapes and may annotate them in its reply.

whiteboard.description: True when the student is at the Whiteboard tab. The tutor then teaches by building its diagram there, adding to the board items it drew on earlier turns.

Turn.description: answer/question require nonblank text. Reuse requestId only with an identical payload for idempotent retry; boardSnapshot is excluded from that comparison. revision must match the current lesson. Turn requests are limited to 3 MB.

DocumentUpdate.description: Exactly one of name, append, or trashed. Appending requires a fresh revisionId and optionally a tabId. Existing content is preserved.

draftQuote.description: If nonempty, an exact substring of the reviewed draft; addressed/partial claims require draft evidence.

AssignmentReview.description: One result for every prepared requirement, without duplicate or unknown requirement IDs. This is formative feedback, not a grade or submission approval.

rubricAvailable.description: Whether an accessible teacher rubric was found; false does not authorize invented grading criteria.

requirementsStale.description: True after teacher instruction or rubric content changes. Derived help/review is cleared and the draft preserved. save remains available; prepare must refresh requirements before help/review.

AssignmentState.description: Persisted assignment workspace. Citations resolve to current lesson passages and quote their exact text. Saving a changed draft clears prior review and help; saving unchanged text retains them. Changes to teacher instructions or rubric content mark requirements stale until prepare refreshes them, preserving the student draft.

question.description: Optional blocker question for help; omitted or empty requests a contextual next hint.

AssignmentInput.description: prepare selects a courseWork post already included in the lesson. Other actions require a prepared workspace. Reuse requestId only with an identical payload for idempotent retries. revision must match the current lesson. Draft text is student-authored work; saving does not call the model.
